  D_decomposition        non-overlapping   <- probed-DtN requires the non-overlapping view, which INTRODUCES cross-points the overlapping scheme does not have
  D_decomposition_axes   ['non-overlapping']
  Lambda_transmission    probed-DtN   <- probing is the exception that makes R1 survivable: probed-DtN requires only bc_channel >= dirichlet, because the higher rung is built outside the expert
  O_ordering             additive   <- multiplicative ordering is forbidden when any composition-layer guarantee depends on equivalent treatment of agents; a direct Schur solve satisfies this automatically, being order-free
  K_accelerator          direct-schur   <- a direct Schur solve makes the solve-incompleteness term vanish, and is order-free so it satisfies R5 by construction rather than by discipline
  C_levels               two(probed-schur)   <- two-level via a classical coarse solve requires an agent that can run at a different window size without changing its regime; via a probed Schur complement it requires nothing extra, since every call stays at the native size
  W_window               1 (DEFAULTED)   <- W* would be about 1/ln(L) clamped by R3, and L is unmeasured (W1), so W* is UNCOMPUTABLE. W = 1 is the honest default and this is the compiler saying it is defaulting rather than choosing
  eps_tol                None (DEFAULTED)   <- unset: the relative rule needs measured tau and sigma (W3)
  overlap                None
  exchange_interval      1.0   <- the exchange interval cannot go below max_i dt_native. The window is the one axis a frozen expert can move along: W can be increased, never decreased
